read.en: SpaceX edged up 0.5% on Oct 12 to $163.42. It is just below its 5-day average ($165) but above the 10-day ($160.4) and 30-day ($152.5); there is no 100-day average yet. MACD is still above its signal, but the histogram has faded from 1.8 to 0.7. Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 2 ($153), and RSI is 59.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月12日小涨 0.5%，收于 $163.42。股价略低于 5 日均线（$165），但高于 10 日（$160.4）和 30 日均线（$152.5）；尚无 100 日均线。MACD 仍在信号线上方，但柱体由 1.8 降至 0.7。抛物线 SAR 自 10月2日起看多（$153），RSI 为 59。

read.en: Rallies stalled at $167–168 on Oct 7 and Oct 12. A close above that reopens $176 (Jun 30 and Oct 6 highs), then the $185–192 mid-June gap. Support is $160 (Oct 8–9 lows, 10-day average), then $152.5–153 (30-day average and SAR) and $145 (Sep 28 low).
read.zh: 10月7日和 10月12日的反弹均在 $167–168 受阻。若收盘站上该区域，可再看 $176（6月30日及10月6日高点），其次 6月中旬缺口 $185–192。支撑为 $160（10月8–9日低点、10 日均线），其次 $152.5–153（30 日均线及 SAR）和 $145（9月28日低点）。
